how: The starter proposes the flag and reports beginning its construction, without making subsequent joining part of the starter role.
A direct request for more people recruits hands to the flag effort.
A member joins the flag effort with a bare acceptance that requests nothing back.
Prospective collaborators weigh scarce space and dedicated defenders against their imagined combined strength.
Participants specify flag proportions and propose lettering, a heart, expansion and a national symbol.
Participants report starting the flag and placing its corner.
The starting report combines a visual reference with dimensions, frame and placement instructions.
Participants try to retain a contested heart and warn that another group is converting their flag.
The added keeper-information mechanism cannot be tested because the heart exchange disputes entitlement without documenting an adopted change and its keepers' information.
Participants attribute covered work and flag changes to named neighbours without independently tracing individual placers.
Visitors ask for tolerance and request that the proposed flag conversion stop.
A neighbour proposes building above its flag with a separating pixel and receives explicit agreement.
A participant proposes converting Austrian flags by correcting their proportions and another calls them easy conversions.
The made flags are celebrated by crediting Baltic helpers and praising the result despite unequal flag sizes.
Participants mark the event's ending and acknowledge that placement is over.
Neighbours supply building help, request assistance for another flag, contribute limited pixels and thank helpers.
A prospective intermediary carries a joint-image proposal and directs cross-room posting while admitting that the other room has not committed.
A participant explains continued flag defence through a family tie rather than personal national membership.
Repeated potato-link posts carry a familiar room joke beside the canvas effort without establishing a canvas claim.
Visitors and hosts exchange accusations, counteraccusations and jokes over incompatible accounts of whose flag the pixels represent.
A proposed joint image cannot count as an adopted coalition when its proposer explicitly lacks the other room's assent.
A title calling related subreddits to talk cannot establish a canvas coalition when the subject and response are missing.
The shared-chat invitation and gratitude for joint building do not reveal the extent of coalition uptake or a shared defensive agreement.
Similar flag colours let participants redescribe conversion as correcting another flag's proportions rather than openly replacing a different design.
Agreed relative placement and an offered corner accompany initial building before the later maintenance announcement.
A shared-chat invitation directs both national groups to team up while leaving attendance, decisions and returned instructions unseen.
A participant jokes that the preview bot supplies a case for the proposed joint image.
Participants turn a national bird and convertible flag into canvas jokes without showing that either joke became a lasting room symbol.
Before building the proposed joint image, participants scout contested space, consider borrowing it and discuss a smaller image.
Participants dispute whether conversion is tolerated, justified by confusing proportions, or condemned as stealing and vandalism.
Requests for a proposed design and location do not document explanation of canvas rules, controls or picture meanings.
Visiting helpers identify themselves without stating whether a canvas mark brought them into the subreddit.
An invitation addressed to existing national groups does not document a new room forming around a canvas mark.
The tolerance objection concerns altering flags rather than documented offence over slurs, jokes or hate symbols.
Naming a player and team as image subjects does not document seeking their attention or press coverage outside the canvas.
Space concerns and urgency do not document a participant leaving under stress or an internal quarrel being repaired.
Taking a public complaint to one's own subreddit does not document concealed strategy, spying or infiltration of rivals.
Warnings about external flag conversion do not document members attacking their own mark because they object to canvas posts.
Continuing defence nine hours later and reporting limited pixels do not identify continuous time spent, devices used or activities displaced.
A preview-bot joke and finite pixel supply do not document site faults or technical workarounds.
Defending a flag for a spouse does not establish belonging to both rooms in a contest.
Scouting another project does not document relocation after losing an established mark.
The unfinished collaboration ends without a documented decision to carry its effort into another canvas or lasting collective.
A joke responding to a preview bot supplies no evidence of automated pixel placement or spare accounts.
Borrowing space is considered without a documented host grant or guest work governed by that host.
Moderator instructions about flag dimensions do not establish a rule containing canvas discussion in the host subreddit.
Dismissing unknown trade deals while claiming earlier occupancy does not decide whether participants reject representative authority or merely dispute another pair's entitlement.
A post-close complaint about a covered flag does not establish correcting another account or contesting a preserved canvas version.
Repeated potato-link titles support a familiar joke but do not identify a special April Fools licence or host takeover.
Justifications based on confusing flags and current stealing disputes do not establish an inherited rivalry.
Visible design instructions and an unseen shared chat cannot decide whether the room explicitly established or lacked organizational offices and rules.
The conversion call and its justification name similar proportions rather than an evidenced pre-canvas tie selecting the rival.
The starter's proposal and initial work precede a further request for people and an explicit join.
The starter's building report predates further recruitment, so that report cannot establish recruitment's causal effect on subsequent construction.
The same passage explicitly shifts from having made the flags to needing to maintain them.
Placement agreements may precede upkeep because neighbours negotiate where an emerging flag should begin.
A placement agreement with one neighbour and tolerance appeals concerning another do not establish a border settlement causing restraint.
Defensive strain is visible but no placement automation is documented from which to test the proposed escalation.
The announcement that the flags were made explicitly credits and thanks the people who helped build them.
Celebration and later loss reports do not explicitly connect celebration to the decision to document events.
Acknowledging closure without a documented continuation decision cannot test whether recording the effort prompted a lasting successor.
Space concerns arise during an uncommitted new collaboration rather than a documented choice to move a lost work.
Posted dimensions need not settle design when neighbour changes prompt edits and participants continue specifying the proportions.
A call for people is followed by a bare join, supporting the acceptance form without observing silent placing or general refusal preferences.
Help can supply the initial build rather than follow a shortage of defensive hands.
Placement talk and offered building help can form one entry arrangement rather than border settlement causing a later exchange of help.
Recruitment preceding a conversion call establishes order but does not show that recruited hands were redirected from building into attack.
Restraint can come from a visiting helper in the host thread rather than an attacking room policing its own members.
A later heart agreement dispute does not identify the earlier conversion call as the cause of negotiation.
The conversion call elicits a tolerance objection and a reply defending alteration, while a later accusation receives an explicit counteraccusation.
Cooperation accompanies neighbouring builds before maintenance calls, without evidence that a shared attack prompted coalition formation.
Recruitment and moderator design instructions do not demonstrate a post flood causing containment of canvas talk.
The revised bound cannot resolve whether the heart reply challenges representative authority when it instead asserts prior occupancy and ignorance of another pair's deal.
